title: Focus on young experts: A qualitative survey of patients on their experiences at Childhood-Haus Berlin
summary: In this study, we want to interview children and young people who were introduced to the Childhood House Berlin in 2023/2024 using a questionnaire about their experiences with the Childhood-Haus Berlin. The children and young people should have the opportunity to report their perception and satisfaction with the individual areas of the Childhood House Berlin (medicine/police/justice/psychosocial). Those affected can also express their ideas for the further development of Childhood-Haus Berlin. Since the topic of online child sexual abuse is becoming increasingly relevant in professional and public discourse, the experience and handling of this topic will be another special focus of the interviews.

interventions.name: Qualitative study with children, adolescents, and young adults (ages 6-21) who were presented at the Childhood-Haus Berlin in 2023/2024, meet the inclusion criteria, are interested in participating in the study, and have provided informed consent, including consent from legal guardians for minors. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Being treated in the Childhood-Haus Berlin in 2023 or 2024
• Possibility to appear in person
• Consent of the legal guardians or consent of those affected if they have reached the age of 18
• Consent of the children and young people
Exclusion criteria:
• Withdrawal of informed consent
• Acute mental illnesses that require immediate therapy (e.g. suicidal tendencies, psychotic symptoms)
• Severe intellectual disability
• Nonverbality
